chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Taymi, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Zurara, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamza, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'When a believer says to his brother, “Uff!” (a sound of mild annoyance/dismiss), he comes out of his guardianship. And if he says, “You are my enemy,” one of the two has blasphemed, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, does not accept from anyone any deed while he is reproaching a believer with sincerity, nor does He accept from a believer any deed while he harbors evil in his heart against a believer.'

'If the covering were lifted from the people, and they looked at the connection between Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and the believer, their necks would become submissive to the believers, their affairs would become easy for them, and their obedience to them would be gentle. And if they looked at the rejected deeds from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, they would say, “Allah, Mighty and Majestic, does not accept from anyone any deed.”'
And I heard him saying to a man from the Shites: 'You are the good ones, and your women are the good ones. Every believing woman is a beautiful Hourie, and every believing man is a truthful one.'

He said, 'And I heard him saying: 'Our Shites are the closest of creatures to the Throne of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, on the Day of Resurrection after us. And there is no one from our Shites who stands to pray except that the number of angels equal to those who opposed him surround him in it, praying for him in congregation until he finishes his prayer. And indeed, the one from among you who fasts is grazing in the gardens of Paradise, and the angels supplicate for him until he breaks his fast.'

And I heard him saying: 'You are the people of Allah's greeting with His peace, and the people of Allah's impact with His mercy, and the people of Allah's guidance with His protection, and the people of Allah's call with His obedience. There is no accounting for you, and no fear, and no grief. You are for Paradise, and Paradise is for you. Your names in our presence are 'the righteous' and 'the reformers'. And you are the people of pleasure from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, with His pleasure for you, and the angels are your brothers in goodness. So if you strive, they supplicate for you, and if you are negligent, they strive for you. And you are the best of the created beings. Your houses are gardens for you, and your graves are gardens for you. For Paradise you were created, and in Paradise is your bliss, and to Paradise you are returning.'

key_terms.أُفٍّ: A sound of mild annoyance or impatience, indicating a minor defect in patience.
key_terms.صِدِّيقٌ: Truthful one, one who is consistently truthful.

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of the Shites according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the elevated ontological status of the Shites as 'Ahl al-Tahiyah' (People of Allah's Greeting), linking their spiritual proximity to the Imams with divine acceptance of deeds. It elaborates on the mechanics of spiritual rejection, noting that even minor irritations ('Uff') or concealed enmity can nullify worship, while simultaneously promising that their homes and graves become gardens due to their inherent righteousness. The text further emphasizes the cosmic validation of their faith, where angels surround them during prayer, reflecting the Shia concept of 'Wilayah' as a conduit for divine mercy and ease in the Hereafter.

en.hubeali: H 15003 – Ahmad Bin Muhammad bin Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al-Hasan Al-Taymi, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Zurara, from Muhammad Bin Al-Fazeyl, from Abu Hamza who said:

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘When the believers says to his brother, ‘Uff!’ he comes out from his guardianship. If he says, ‘You are my enemy’, one of the two has blasphemed, because Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic does not Accept the deeds from anyone during the reproach of a Believer, and does not Accept from a Believer any deeds whilst he harbours evil in his heart against a Believer.

If the covering is Lifted from the people, so they will see to the Means of what is between Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic and the Believers. Their necks would become submissive to the Believers, and their matters would become easier for them and they would be obedient to them. And if they were to look at the deeds rejected by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, they would say, ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic does not Accept the deeds from anybody’.

And I (the narrator) heard him<sup>asws</sup> say to a man from the Shites: ‘You all are the good ones, and your women are the good ones. Every Believing woman is a beautiful Hourie, and every believing man is a truthful one’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Our<sup>asws</sup> Shites would be the closest of the creatures to the Throne of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic on the Day of Judgement after us<sup>asws</sup>. And there is no one from our<sup>asws</sup> Shites who stand to Pray except that the number of Angels equal to the ones opposed to him Pray for him in congregation for him until he is free from his Salat (Prayer). And the one from among you who Fasts will be enjoying in the Gardens of the Paradise, and the Angels prepare it for him until he breaks the Fast’.

And I (the narrator) heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘You (Shites) are the people Greeted by the Greetings of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the people Impacted by the Mercy of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the people Guided by the Protection of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the people Invited by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for being obedient to Him<sup>azwj</sup>. There is no Accounting for you (Shites), and no fear, and no grief. You are all for the Paradise and the Paradise is for you all. Your names (titles) in our<sup>asws</sup> presence are, ‘the righteous’, and ‘the reformers’. And you are the people of the Pleasure of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Him<sup>azwj</sup> being Pleased with you, and the Angels are your brothers in the good. So if you are striving, they supplicate for you, and if you are in neglect, they strive for you. And you are the best of the created beings. Your houses are gardens for your (living ones), and the graves are the garden for your (deceased). It is for the Paradise that you have been created, and it is in the Paradise that you will be Favoured by, and it is to the Paradise that you are travelling to’.
en.sarwar: 557. Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al-Nahdy, from Muhammad Bin Al-Waleed, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al-Fazeyl, who has said the following:

Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said: ‘The Rasool Allah (saww) said to Ja’far (as) when he (as) came back from Ethiopia; ‘Which was the most astonishing thing from what you (as) saw?’ He (as) said; ‘I saw an Ethiopian woman pass by and upon her head was a load. So a man passed by her and bumped into her, and the load fell from her head. She sat down, then said, ‘Woe be unto you from the Judge on the Day of Reckoning, when He (azwj) will Sit upon the Chair, and Take for the oppressed, from the oppressors’. So the Rasool Allah (saww) was (pleased with) astonishing (tale)’.
